run_optimizer_minimize: run a nevergrad NGOpt optimizer to minimize a function and get the best recommendation
create_instrumentation_params: create an Instrumentation with Array and Scalar parameters for multi-variable optimization
test_constrained_optimization: test constrained optimization by registering a cheap constraint on the first variable
run_callback_registration: run an optimizer with a tell callback that prints candidate and value at each step
test_inoculation_suggest: test inoculation by suggesting a candidate value and telling its loss to the optimizer
